entities.name: Andrés Feliz
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Andrés Rafael Feliz Sarita is a Dominican basketball player for Real Madrid of the Spanish Liga ACB and the EuroLeague. He played college basketball for the Northwest Florida State Raiders and the Illinois Fighting Illini. He has represented the Dominican Republic in FIBA-sanctioned international youth and senior level competitions and was the top scorer at the 2015 FIBA Under-19 World Championship.
